from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Charge(BaseModel):
    """A specific criminal charge found within the document."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="The specific name of the charge (e.g., 串通投标罪)")
    category: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal category if explicitly stated (e.g., 破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪)")

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from one document regarding its case type and charges."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The stated cause of action/case type in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal proceeding (e.g., 刑事，民事，行政)")
    charges: list[Charge] = Field(description="List of criminal charges identified in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[CaseInfo]
